Figure 1: Overview of RayViT. Camera geometry is injected through a ray-map–conditioned class token and patch-aligned ray embeddings. An intermediate cross-view consistency loss regularizes the visual representation. Visual tokens, frozen CLIP [19] language tokens, and noisy action tokens are processed by a decoder-only xLSTM policy [41, 42].
